summary: This bill establishes a three-year cycle, beginning in fiscal year 2026, to reduce funding for federal programs whose authorization has expired, with a 10% reduction in the first year and 15% in the second and third years, leading to termination if not reauthorized by Congress with a three-year sunset provision.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly aims to reduce government spending by establishing a mechanism to cut funding for unauthorized programs over a three-year cycle, ultimately terminating them if not reauthorized. This is the central purpose of the bill.

By mandating reductions in spending for unauthorized programs, the bill indirectly contributes to prioritizing debt reduction by curbing expenditures. While not directly about the national debt, its primary mechanism of spending cuts would have a positive impact on reducing the deficit.
